research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Chronicles Hunt's 19-year fight for freedom; racial dynamics contributing to conviction. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While the specific Dateline episode title "Twisted" wasn't confirmed via search, Darryl Hunt's case is a significant wrongful conviction story involving racial bias, flawed eyewitness accounts, jailhouse informants, and ultimately, exoneration through DNA after nearly two decades. Dateline likely covered this high-profile case.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Rape and Murder (of Deborah Sykes in 1984)
contributing_factors_raw: Eyewitness misidentification, jailhouse informants, recanted witness statements, racial bias (convicted by all-white jury in second trial)
featured_individuals.status_raw: Exonerated by DNA evidence (which identified actual perpetrator Willard E. Brown); Received settlement; Died 2016
organizations_involved_raw: Darryl Hunt Project for Freedom and Justice (founded by him); Innocence Project (assisted with DNA efforts)
